permission_gate_policy.principle: AI composer is a derivative enhancement layer; the canonical gate runs BEFORE skill_execution_chain. Denied / pending paths return before execution and write no evidence.

permanent_deny.PUSH: AI composer never publishes / pushes / deletes; permanently denied at this boundary regardless of approval.

four_states.pending_approval: permission level met but high-risk human approval token missing; HTTP 200, no execution, no evidence.
four_states.denied: insufficient permission / unregistered / cross-domain; HTTP 403, no execution, no evidence.
four_states.permanent_deny: action class forbidden at this boundary; HTTP 403, no execution.
